250-779-1315-1479-8293.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-8293.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1315-1479-8293.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

413-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-7936--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
When Dominion Saboteur enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat.

129-1978-5793-6700.description:
Activate Sarevok's Tome by tapping it, adding two mana.
Kinnan triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sarevok's Tome which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
129-1978-5793-6700.notes: If you have completed a dungeon, you can activate Sarevok's Tome's last ability any number of times to cast all nonland cards in your library.

1368-6321-7060-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-7060-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, X-23 triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on X-23 and the other Mutant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

292-1495-7741.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-7741.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

948-2034-7363-7426.description:
Activate a Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Berta, creating a 1/1 Ooze creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ooze, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5223-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3755-4871-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3755-4871-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

104-3000-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-3000-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

323-2292-5170-6132.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3480-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2366-3430-4785-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-4785-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

681-1315-5478-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-1315-5478-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-549-2511-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 2 or higher

1318-1537-5352.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-1537-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Zealous Conscripts and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Zealous Conscripts and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Zealous Conscripts and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Zealous Conscripts tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-1537-5352.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Zealous Conscripts. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

2957-4508-5491-5880.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Map and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

152-2034-5446-6753.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2634-4668-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
2634-4668-5259.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the Rude Awakening copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
2634-4668-5259.notes: The number of lands needed can be reduced if opponents have drawn cards this turn due to Heliod.

uses.battlefieldCardState: cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-5658-6441.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to create two token copies of Éomer and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Put both Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2928-5657-6489.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
2928-5657-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
2928-5657-6489.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1849-3372-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1849-3372-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

997-1636-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
997-1636-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1339-1926-4924.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Insect" chosen with Species Specialist.
1339-1926-4924.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Species Specialist triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1394-1651-3340-4321.description:
Activate Power Depot by tapping it, creating a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Treasure, untapping Power Depot.
Repeat.

396-560-2034-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorn and Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

803-4302-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-4302-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

224-1525-4488-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-4488-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Rampaging Baloths trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

1061-1692.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Timestream Navigator.
You have the City's Blessing.
1061-1692.description:
Go to combat, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the token copy of Timestream Navigator to take an extra turn.
Move to next turn.
